context.transcript:
Good afternoon, everyone.
As Chief Operating Officer, one of my responsibilities is to look for ways to reduce costs.
With this in mind, the Executive Leadership Team and I have made the decision to consolidate our company from two locations to one, and one of our buildings will be sold.
And since many of you have expressed interest in hybrid work schedules, employees will be able to work from home or in the office on different days of the week.
Please think about a schedule that would best suit your work productivity.
Be sure to discuss it with your manager by the end of this week.

context.transcript_translation:
大家下午好。
作为首席运营官，我的职责之一是寻找降低成本的方法。
考虑到这一点，执行领导团队和我决定将公司从两个地点整合到一个地点，其中一栋楼将被出售。
由于许多人对混合工作安排表示了兴趣，员工将在一周的不同日子在家或在办公室工作。
请考虑最适合您工作效率的日程安排。
请务必在本周末前与您的经理讨论此事。
